photo.caption: Illustration of a site conceptual model for environmental exposure
photo.alt: Illustration of a site conceptual model for environmental exposure. Illustrates a hazard source, environmental fate and transport, exposure point, exposure route, and potentially exposed populations.
photo.description: This figure is an example of a site conceptual model used for exposure pathway evaluation. It demonstrates the source of a given hazard, environmental fate and transport, the exposure point, the route of exposure, and the potential receptors for exposure.
